A SYNTHETIC TEST BOOK
(Invented text for tests. Not from East of Eden.)

Contents
Chapter 1
Chapter 2
Chapter 3

Chapter 1

The orchard stood at the edge of the valley. Two brothers planted it in a dry spring.
The older one said, “We will water it every day.”

Chapter 2

A stranger arrived with a letter. Nobody read it until the rains came — late, and heavy.

CHAPTER III

The younger brother opened the letter at last. He told his brother what it said.
